description: Five named components form the Wabamun Lake geological CO2-storage test problem: formation-water chemistry, drillstem-test pressure/permeability, formation depths, well locations/depths and core analyses. The common source description explains that the data support model comparison for subsurface injection near industrial CO2 sources. It describes saline formations and confining shale as candidate storage conditions, not an operating storage facility. Titles state comma-separated point tables. A chemistry archive descriptor instead labels ASCII GRID; that representation conflict is retained and no raster is inferred. The metadata are dated February 2006; observation periods are not specified. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
